name: Two pointers (slow / fast)
whenToUse: Always for this problem: one pass, in place, order kept.

card.signals: "in place" (no copy allowed), "keep the relative order" and "move some values to one end". Together they point to two pointers that move in the same direction: fast reads, slow writes.
card.pattern: one pass, O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Each non-zero is swapped at most once.
card.coreIdea: fast finds each non-zero, slow marks the next free slot for it, and a swap sends the non-zero left and pushes a zero right.

invariant: Left of slow: only non-zeros, in their original order. From slow up to fast: only zeros.

legend.text: slow: next free slot for a non-zero
